issues.description: The problem statement specifies that Genre has an optional recursive Genre named `subgenre` (i.e. subgenre should be of type `Genre?`), but the solution implements `subgenre` as a `String?`. This is an attribute type mismatch: the intended recursive structure (a sub-Genre object) is replaced in the solution by a simple string name. Students reading the problem will expect to model a recursive Genre relationship and to access `subgenre` as a Genre (e.g. `genre.subgenre?.name`), but the solution shows `subgenre` as a String, which uses a different data model and usage pattern. This mismatch can confuse students about the intended type and how to construct/print nested genres, and it prevents direct reuse of the solution code if the recursive model from the problem statement is expected.
